title: Nvidia CEO Resignation Accelerates Hyperscaler Shift Toward Custom ASICs
digest: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's resignation (as of Nov 13, 2026) has triggered concerns over governance and national security risks, accelerating hyperscaler diversification toward custom ASIC architectures. Broadcom (AVGO) is positioned to benefit, with its XPU-based AI acceleration driving semiconductor revenue growth. The shift reflects hyperscalers' efforts to reduce dependency on Nvidia's GPUs amid regulatory scrutiny and architectural limitations.

representative.summary: Broadcom 股价在 AI 领域调整后领涨半导体复苏，得益于 XPU 采用加速和 AI 网络需求增长。NVIDIA 领导层危机加剧，CEO 黄仁勋离职，可能促使超大规模计算向自定义 ASIC 架构转移，利好 Broadcom。这将加速 Broadcom 转化积压需求，推动未来两年多倍 AI 收入增长。
